reading: TV critics have welcomed Nigella Lawson as a new judge on The Great British Bake Off.
Channel 4 will show the first episode of series 17 on 22 September.
The opening episode was shown to critics earlier this week.
Lawson replaces Prue Leith, who wanted to spend less time working and more time enjoying herself.
Anita Singh of the Telegraph suggested that Lawson’s memorable comments could become popular on social media.
The new participants have different backgrounds, including work in medicine, hairdressing and the arts.
Moyin is a student who balances his studies with athletics.
He uses flavours inspired by his Nigerian heritage in his baking.
Yannis is a doctor who wants to challenge an unfair belief about Bangladeshi men cooking.
Connie works in a hospital and uses baking to relax after a busy day.
